title: Ilizwi Elachasa Ulawulo Lwesithixo
intro: Phakathi kwabathunywa bakaSomandla kwakukho umkhonzi oqinileyo owaphakama phakathi kwesizwe esineenkani ukuze ahambise inyaniso. Abantu babo babesele bethathe uthixo ongeyonyani, bemshiya uMdali wazo zonke izinto ezikhoyo. Ngesigqibo esingagungqiyo, lo mntu wababiza ukuba babuye - kodwa umyalezo wahlangatyezwa ngokukhanyelwa nokulahlwa. Jonga izikhokelo ukuze ufumane ukuba ngubani lo mkhonzi uzinikeleyo.
clues: Ndathunyelwa njengomthunywa kubantu abaneenkani ababephambukele kude nendlela ethe tye.
Ndize kukhumbuza isizwe sam ngoLowo wadala konke okukhoyo — oyena mdali ubalaseleyo kubo bonke.
Abantu bam babeguqukele kwisithixo sobuxoki ababesihlonela kwaye besibiza imini nobusuku.
Ndawaphikisa ngesibindi, ndiwabuza ukuba kutheni beya kunqula uthixo ongeyonyani baze bamlahle iNkosi yabo yokwenene.
Bandikhanyele, bala ukuphulaphula, baza babambelela ebuxokini babo—kodwa iNkosi yam yandilondoloza.
NdinguIlyas — kwaye uxolo lwandinikwa, kwaye ndabalwa phakathi kwabakhonzi abakholwayo boSobubele.
